what: Byte-for-byte copy of the collaborator's Integration Package (Nyati / Lake Cement Sales Dashboard), vendored so the Lake Cement MIS can host the Streamlit Sales Dashboard and read the two e-mail reports' live figures. Nothing here is edited; integrity is checked by SHA256SUMS in this folder.
package: integration_package (prepared 14 Oct 2026; source on the collaborator's laptop: C:\odoo-sales-dashboard)
layout: Flat, as on the collaborator's laptop: every module finds .env and outbox/ relative to its own folder.

deliberately_not_vendored.why: These send e-mail through desktop Outlook or register Windows scheduled tasks. The e-mails stay on the collaborator's Windows PC, unchanged; this server must never send them or schedule them, so the files are not here at all.

added_here_not_from_package: web_extract.py — reads the two e-mail reports' live figures through the collaborator's own functions, read-only, no sending
sitecustomize_pg_ssl.py — switches the Odoo database connection to encrypted without editing odoo_client.py
email-schedule.json — the e-mail schedule facts, copied from the non-vendored scripts (with their SHA-256)
README.md — how it is hosted and operated
